title: flywheel: orch_pi_models input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_pi_models instead; removed in v4.0] Pick models for Pi lanes from your own Pi logins (xai, meta, openai-codex, zai and others, each model verified by a cached test call) and the live Vercel AI Gateway catalog. action="list" ranks frontier models for the deep-plan roles by list price and balanced models for the implementer by gateway usage, puts logins ahead of metered gateway routes, and returns one AskUserQuestion payload per role in data.questions; the implementer question is multiSelect. action="choose" takes the answers keyed by role, resolves each to a `pi --model` value, runs pi auth check for each provider, remembers the picks in .pi-flywheel/pi-models.json, and returns data.piModels (the implementer value is comma-separated) plus data.piReady.

action.description: list=rank models and build the questions, choose=validate and remember the answers

roles.description: Lanes to ask about with action=list. Deep plan uses ["robustness","ergonomics"]; swarms use ["implementer"] (the default).

picks.description: Required with action=choose. Maps a role to the chosen option label or `pi --model` value. The implementer takes up to 3, as an array or a comma-separated string.

refresh.description: Refetch the gateway catalog and re-run the login model probes even when the caches are fresh.
